protocol.title: PE beads · Exp 11 · Rate constants, settling and depletion
protocol.summary: Measure association, post-wash dissociation, delayed detection and a detection-antibody clamp to separate the two off-rates; test settling and bead number.

children.body: PE after the wash decays at k₋₂ + k₋₃; separating the two needs a perturbation.
Pins: k₁ and k₂ (11a), k₋₂ + k₋₃ and rebinding (11b), k₋₁ (11c), k₋₃ and the k₋₃ ≈ k₋₁ assumption (11d), settling and transport (11e), and analyte depletion by the beads (11f).

Image every time point in a fresh well or a fresh field, once. Re-imaging a field bleaches the next time point. Keep the wash-to-image time fixed, settle beads by a 1 min plate spin (gravity alone takes longer than the timing window), and log the room temperature: k₋₂ depends on it.

children.body: With k₋₂ + k₋₃ = [!var:k_sum] the PE signal halves every [!var:t_half_min]; [!var:loss_delay_pct] is gone by the first well and a further [!var:spread_pct] by the last. Beads settle [!var:h_mm] of liquid in [!var:t_settle_min] by gravity or [!var:t_spin_s] in a [!var:rcf] plate spin. During a clamp at [!var:d0_nm], a fraction [!var:f_lab] of captured analyte is labelled.
Association, one-step
Analyte at ≈0.1×, 1× and 10× the expected K_D1, PE-antibody at the working D₀, all added together to the beads. Rotate.
Stop (wash) and image at
Dissociation after the wash (k₋₂ + k₋₃)
Equilibrate one-step at a mid concentration (overnight, rotating). Wash. Split into two arms: plain buffer, and buffer with ≈100 nM unlabelled detection antibody (blocks rebinding).
Image fresh fields at 0, 5, 15, 30 and 60 min, then every 30 min to 4 h, in both arms.
Delayed detection (k₋₁)
Two-step: capture analyte without PE-antibody, wash, hold in buffer for 0, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240 min (separate wells).
At each hold time add saturating PE-antibody for a fixed time (≥ the re-label time in the calculator), wash, image.

Same-bead variant: after a one-step incubation and wash, hold, image one set of fields as is (decays at k₋₂ + k₋₃), then relabel the same well and image fresh fields (decays at k₋₁). The ratio cancels bead-to-bead site variation.
Clamp with PE-antibody present (k₋₃)
After a one-step equilibrium, replace the liquid with buffer containing PE-antibody at D₀ and no analyte. Image fresh fields over 2–4 h in the no-wash mode (20x, 1 AU).
Settling and transport
One mid concentration, 2 h, three arms: static, orbital shaking, end-over-end rotation.
Bead number
A low analyte concentration with 1,000, 5,000 and 20,000 beads in the same volume, 2 h, rotating.

Before any quantitative acquisition: stand and lasers on for 2–3 h; 561 nm excitation; the same PE emission band (e.g. 570–620 nm) every time; 16-bit with fine integration (the default is 12-bit, so check the file); one HV and one offset for the whole session; background mode at least 50 DN above zero; no saturated pixels. Record the transmitted-light channel with every PE frame: beads are found in it, never in PE. Find focus in transmitted light and hold it with Perfect Focus. Never live-scan PE to focus.
11a: global fit of the binding model (Research/bead_confocal_sim/binding.py) to all time points and concentrations, with bead number and volume fixed: k₁ and k₂.
11b: fit PE(t) = PE(0)·exp(−Λt) in each arm. If the arms agree, rebinding is negligible and Λ = k₋₂ + k₋₃.

11c: PE against hold time decays at k₋₁. With k₋₃ ≈ k₋₁, k₋₂ = Λ − k₋₁. If capture is nearly irreversible (≈3 × 10⁻⁶ s⁻¹ has been reported for a PSA capture antibody), 11b alone measures k₋₂ and 11c bounds k₋₁.
11d: PE decays at f·k₋₃ + (1 − f)·k₋₁ (f from the calculator); at f near 1 that is k₋₃. Compare with 11c.
11e: static versus rotation is the settling effect; shaking versus rotation is per-bead transport (Damköhler number).
11f: PE per bead falling with bead number means analyte depletion; bead number must then be held fixed.
Decision: incubation time and mixing, the fixed bead number, the wash-to-image window (or a no-wash read), and the rate constants for the standard-curve model.
Record for every acquisition

Save the .nd2 files as acquired (no 8-bit export, no LUT) in a folder outside the website repo, e.g. BeadConfocalData/<date>_<exp>/, and fill one plate-map CSV row per well or field (columns are listed in Research/PE_bead_confocal_experiments.md, section 7).
